blurb: Kennedy Point Marina provides dockage for boats up to 80 feet with modern power pedestals and all-slip pump outs. Amenities include clean restrooms, hot showers, laundry, picnic area, and BBQ grills. The marina is located on a calm lagoon known for manatees and offers premium views of rocket launches at Kennedy Space Center.
extraNote: Some areas of the marina may be temporarily closed during clubhouse and office renovations starting 7/13/2026

quotes.author: Garryrhyne08
quotes.text: I've been here a month and this place is great. Friendly people lots to do and see . Dock master Chris is great. He keeps a eye on everything and makes sure everything is ship shape. I draw 5'6" and had no problem getting in.

quotes.author: Ashley
quotes.text: We had a great stay here. Everyone was friendly, welcoming and helpful. Pump out vavles at the slips. Easy to get in and out with 5 ft draft. Highly recommend this marina.
